info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Authorization Details Retrieval API
info.description: The Authorization Details Retrieval API allows users to access specific authorization details related to institution logins for customers. This API provides comprehensive information about the authorization status and associated transactions for a given customer institution. Typical consumers include financial institutions and customer support teams seeking to verify login authorizations and transaction histories. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance their applications with detailed insights into customer authorizations, improving user experience and operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve authorization details for a specific institution login.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the authorization details associated with a specified institution login. It provides relevant information that can be used for various purposes, such as verification, analytics, and user session management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to obtain the authorization details for the specified institution login. It encompasses the necessary data to successfully process the request and retrieve relevant information pertaining to the authorization details.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning authorization details.

GetAuthorizationDetailsForInstitutionLog.description: This schema represents the authorization details required for the institution logins, used in the context of the GET operation.

GetAuthorizationDetailsForInstitutionLog.title: Authorization Details Response

institutionLoginId.description: Unique identifier for the institution login.

authorizationStartDate.description: The start date of the authorization period.

authorizationEndDate.description: The end date of the authorization period.
